description: This minified JavaScript file contains localization strings for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, specifically for the Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) language. It defines translations for UI components such as font styles, image handling, video embedding, links, tables, formatting options, lists, colors, shortcuts, help texts, and more.

methods.name: e.extend
methods.description: A method call to extend the existing language object with Chinese translations for Summernote.
